question: Can a team of agents improve a blind transit search faster than hand tuning, and does the improved search recover planets the TESS team announced after 2026-07-01?

record.title: Can agents improve a blind transit search faster than hand tuning?
record.body: Start from the box least squares baseline and measure every change against the frozen scorer on the same dev targets.

record.title: Promote baseline as the first champion
record.body: The baseline becomes the reference for paired comparisons.

record.title: Detrending window sets the floor for shallow transits
record.body: Hippke et al. (2019) show that a biweight filter with a window three times the longest expected duration preserves transit depth while removing stellar variability. doi:10.3847/1538-3881/ab3984

record.title: Transit least squares beats BLS on small planets
record.body: Hippke & Heller (2019) report a 10 percent recall gain at fixed false alarm rate by fitting a limb-darkened template. arXiv:1901.02015

record.title: Most missed planets are lost to a detrending window that eats the transit
record.body: Agent-generated. 61 of 209 missed dev planets have durations above 4 hours, where the 0.5 day median filter removes up to half the depth. Expected gain +0.03, cost 12 experiment-minutes.

record.title: Scattered light at orbit boundaries produces the false alarms that set the threshold
record.body: Agent-generated. 7 of 8 control false alarms sit within 1 day of a TESS orbit gap. Masking those edges should lower the threshold. Expected gain +0.02, cost 10 experiment-minutes.

record.title: A limb-darkened template will pull shallow injections above threshold
record.body: Agent-generated. Expected gain +0.015, cost 25 experiment-minutes because the search is three times slower.

record.title: Round 1: test the detrending window and edge masking
record.body: Both cheap hypotheses fit the budget with room for a full run each. The template search waits because its cost per minute of learning is lowest.

record.title: Biweight gain holds across depth bins
record.body: The gain is spread over 3 to 8 hour durations and does not come from a single sector. No blocking risk.

record.title: Promote the biweight detrender
record.body: Net gain of 18 targets with p = 0.003. Edge masking helped controls but alone is not enough; next round combines it with the new detrender.

record.title: Edge masking stacks with the biweight detrender
record.body: Agent-generated. The two changes act on different failure modes. Expected gain +0.02, cost 12 experiment-minutes.

record.title: A finer period grid recovers short-period planets
record.body: Agent-generated. 14 missed planets have periods under 1.2 days and fall between grid points. Expected gain +0.01, cost 18 experiment-minutes.

record.title: Round 2: stack edge masking, refine the period grid, try the template
record.body: All three fit this round's budget now that the detrender is settled.

record.title: Masked edges remove real transits in 2 targets
record.body: Two planets with transits within 0.3 days of the gap are lost. The net effect is still positive; not blocking.

record.title: Promote the masked biweight pipeline
record.body: Net gain of 21 targets with p < 0.001. The template search is too slow for its gain and is shelved.

record.title: Odd-even depth checks can lower the control threshold
record.body: Agent-generated. Eclipsing binaries in the controls set the threshold. Expected gain +0.015, cost 10 experiment-minutes.

record.title: Search two harmonics of each peak
record.body: Agent-generated. 9 planets are found at half or double period. Expected gain +0.01, cost 8 experiment-minutes.

record.title: Round 3: odd-even rejection and harmonic search
record.body: Both are cheap. The fine grid stays shelved.

record.title: Promote odd-even rejection and stop
record.body: Net gain of 12 targets with p = 0.02. Two of three rounds improved the champion; the holdout is next.

record.title: Approve one holdout run of the champion
record.body: Approved by the operator.

record.title: TIC 256009925 at 5.5026 d
record.body: Passes all vetting checks.

record.title: TIC 294167847 at 3.3992 d
record.body: Passes all vetting checks.

record.body: Flags: odd_even_mismatch.

record.body: Flags: secondary_eclipse, v_shape.

record.body: Passes all vetting checks.

record.title: Summary
record.body: The champion went from 0.172 to 0.269 on dev in three rounds and scored 0.251 on the blind holdout.
